description: An upright wooden appliance with two posts and an adjustable crossbar that holds the sewing supports (cords or tapes) taut and vertical while the sections of a book are sewn to them by hand.
name: sewing frame

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter VII, p.98. Internet Archive.
